name: 312 GRIT at Jefferson

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 16 yrs

description: 312 Grit is a functional fitness and personal development program designed for individuals who aspire to elevate their health, performance, and overall quality of life. The program integrates high-level functional training with education in proper nutrition and intentional character development, creating a well-rounded approach to long-term success. At its core, 312 Grit focuses on improving sports performance, strength, conditioning, mobility, and resilience through purposeful, scalable workouts. Beyond physical training, participants are guided in building sustainable nutrition habits that support performance, recovery, and lifelong wellness. What sets 312 Grit apart is its emphasis on developing the character traits of tomorrow’s leaders: discipline, accountability, grit, teamwork, and integrity. Through mentorship, structured competition, and shared challenges, athletes learn to push beyond comfort while supporting one another in a team-centered environment. 312 Grit is more than a workout class; it is a mentoring-driven community where individuals are challenged to grow physically, mentally, and emotionally. The program prepares participants not only to perform at a higher level in sport, but to lead with confidence, resilience, and purpose in every area of life.

name: Adaptive Dance at McFetridge

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: This creative dance workshop invites students ages 6-10 with physical disabilities to explore the joy of movement in a welcoming, inclusive space designed just for them. Together, we'll discover essential movement concepts — like shape, space, level, and energy — through playful, age-appropriate improvisation and engaging dance activities. Every mover's body is celebrated as a source of creativity and expression. There's no "right way" to move here — just curiosity, exploration, and the confidence that grows when students feel seen and supported in expressing themselves authentically. Caregivers are welcome to stay and assist as needed, ensuring every student has the support they need to fully participate and shine. Come move, explore, and dance with us!

name: America: Songs of Protest and Freedom at South Shore

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: 2026 marks the 250th anniversary of the United States. America: Songs and Stories of Protest and Freedom is a multi-genre concert of spoken word and music. It’s written and narrated by award-winning journalist, Cheryl Corley, and features a stellar band led by singer/songwriter Lucy Smith. The concert chronicles America’s story from its founding years to the 21st century. It includes Walt Whitman’s “I Hear America Singing” along with the words of other American authors. Songs include: Curtis Mayfield’s “This is My Country,” John Lennon’s “Imagine,” and Beyonce’s “Freedom.” It is a performance that presents the intricacies of America’s 250 years.

name: Anchor Open Studio Hours at Ellis

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: What stories, sounds, and memories live in Ellis Park? As our Anchor Curatorial Resident, Brother El is opening the studio each month to listen, connect, and record oral stories from Ellis Park and neighborhood participants. His practice begins with listening—to the rhythms already moving through a place and the people who give it meaning. These open studio hours are an invitation to share a story, a memory, a perspective, or simply a conversation. Together, we’re building a living archive of the neighborhood—one that honors where we’ve been, reflects where we are, and helps imagine what comes next. Community is not just the audience. Community is part of the composition. Come listen. Come share. Be part of the frequency. Open to all ages, family-friendly. To learn more about the Anchor Curator-in-Residence, please visit this site.

name: ASM: Lifeguard Explorers at Austin Town Hall

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 14 yrs but less than 20 yrs

description: The Chicago Park District is committed to identifying and training swimmers from around the city. We will teach you the required skills and provide supervised practice time needed to successfully pass the lifeguard test, and become eligible to be hired as a Chicago Park District Lifeguard. Open to High School students of the ages of 14 - 19 years old. Participants who complete all fifteen classes, apply to be a Chicago Park District Lifeguard and attempt the Lifeguard Skills test will receive a stipend 4-6 weeks after their test. Explorers who pass the test will be offered a position as a Lifeguard or Shallow Water Attendant at a pool near the Lifeguard Explorers location.

name: Bird Collisions in the Anthropocene at Big Marsh

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Join the Chicago Park District and Bird Collisions in the Anthropocene for a bird-making workshop at Big Marsh Park. Participants will use upcycled cloth and donated materials to handcraft life-sized bird sculptures. Each artwork commemorates a real bird that lost its life after hitting glass — and connects each crafter with a bird species at risk of building collisions. ​​All of the artworks will be sewn together into a huge 300-foot-long “carpet” of birds that will travel the country as an educational art installation, raising awareness about the toll of building collisions on our bird populations. The full project will take 4 to 6 years, with a likely completion date of 2029.

name: Boat Locker Rental Application at River

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: The Chicago Park District has made available 36 boat lockers at the River Park Boathouse (3000 W. Argyle) for city of Chicago residents to store personal watercraft (kayaks and canoes). Rentals will be offered on an annual basis. Storage units are for non-motorized watercraft only, which may not exceed 18 ft long, 42 in. wide, or 25.5 in. tall. Applications for a boat locker will be accepted through February 28, 2026. Only one application per household will be considered, and selected on a first come, first served basis. If selected, patrons will be required to comply with all associated rules, submit a waiver of liability, and pay an annual rental fee of $250. A wait list will be maintained for those not selected.

name: Bocce at Warren

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Bocce is a test of muscle control and accuracy, requiring high focus and concentration. The goal of the sport is to throw/bowl game balls so they land as close as possible to a special target ball, the 'jack'. Similar to Lawn Bowling, bocce ball is a leisure activity that can be played competitively. Join others and participate in this fun activity.

name: Bollywood Groove Indian Dances & Stories at Seward

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Get ready to GROOVE! Transform your evening into a Bollywood bash with Bollywood Groove Indian Dances & Stories! We’re bringing the high-octane energy of India straight to your local park. This will be an all-out cultural party where ancient folktales meet modern beats. Watch spectacular performances, then jump in to learn the moves yourself! Whether you’re a tiny dancer or a cool grandparent, you’ll be grooving to the rhythm of the Dhol in no time.Grab your picnic blanket and join us. It’s free, it’s vibrant, and it’s going to be legendary!

Cardio Tennis is the ultimate high energy tennis-fitness activity, delivering a full-body, calorie-burning, aerobic & anaerobic workout experience! This group exercise program is for anyone regardless of your tennis skill level by combining the best parts of tennis and fitness in a fun, energetic, and welcoming format. Players will get their hearts pumping through the warmup and cardio segments with unique Cardio Tennis games and high-energy music. You’ll finish off with the reward of a well-earned cooldown. All fitness and ability levels are welcome. Participants must be able to move and be injury free. Participants should come with their own racket and wear appropriate tennis court shoes and bring water and a hat or sunscreen depending on day/time/season. Class size is limited. description: Chair Yoga is a yoga class to make yoga accessible for individuals who have challenges in a typical yoga class setting. Perfect for those who have knee issues, difficulty getting on the floor, balance challenges, limited range of motion, or fluctuating energy levels; chair yoga uses the chair and various props to strengthen the body, assist with flexibility, increase range of motion, decrease stress, and improve balance. Various modifications are provided to meet students where they are at in their yoga practice.

name: City-Wide Symphony Orchestra Holiday Concert at Jefferson

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

location: Copernicus Center, 5216 W. Lawrence Ave, Chicago IL 60630
description: Purchase your tickets TODAY! Best Holiday Concert for the entire family! Come celebrate the season and experience the magic of live symphonic music right here in Chicago! The Chicago Park District proudly welcomes Jefferson Memorial Park’s historic City-Wide Symphony Orchestra back to the Copernicus Center, 5216 W. Lawrence Ave, for its 79th Season Holiday Concert! Bring the whole family for an unforgettable evening of holiday movie classics performed by a majestic 75-piece symphony orchestra inside one of Chicago's most treasured venues. • Door Open: 6pm • Concert Begins: 7pm • Tickets: $12 adults, $7 seniors, kids 12 & under free Presented by: Jefferson Memorial Park Advisory Council • The Chicago Park District • Chicago City Wide Orchestra • Copernicus Foundation Founded in 1947, the City-Wide Symphony Orchestra is an all-volunteer community ensemble that has brought together Chicago-area musicians of all ages for nearly eight decades. Their performances enrich the city’s cultural life and celebrate music as a lifelong pursuit. For 79 years, the CWSO has proudly called Jefferson Park home, staying true to its mission of keeping live orchestral music accessible to the community. We can’t wait to celebrate the season with you!

description: This class is an introduction to the fun and diverse discipline of Dance Acrobatics. Students will work on strength and flexibility, and will use those skills to learn acrobatics basics such as cartwheels, handstands, and limber tricks. Instruction will be diversified based on individual ability. Students will also work on incorporating these skills into dances, including musicality and transitions with their basic skills. It is recommended but not required that students also take Jazz, in order to build their dance skills.

Instruction will be diversified based on individual ability. Students will learn to incorporate these skills into choreography, including musicality and transitions between skills. It is recommended but not required that students also take Jazz, in order to build their dance skills.

name: Dancing on the Spot Presents Artist(s) Statement! at Berger

For more info about Material, check out their website: www.materialstudiosandgallery.com/

name: Día de Los Muertos Workshops & Ofrenda Walk at Steelworkers

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Join neighbors and community members for a special Día de los Muertos gathering at Steelworkers Park on the evening of November 1. Participants are invited to contribute photographs, cherished objects, flowers, and other meaningful items to community altar tables, honoring loved ones and celebrating the traditions and symbolism of Día de los Muertos. As dusk arrives, we’ll gather around a bonfire to share stories, reflect, and enjoy the warmth of community. Hot beverages and seasonal treats will be provided as we celebrate remembrance, connection, and the lives of those who came before us.

name: Early Bird Walks at NPV

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: The Nature Center trails are open early for a morning hike and bird watching during the fall migration season. Binoculars and field guides are available for free use upon request once the Nature Center opens at 9am. Join a group of birders, led by J'orge Garcia of Windy City Bird Lab, or enjoy a self-guided walk. Beginners are welcome. Co-sponsored with Chicago Bird Alliance. No registration necessary, parking and entry are always free!

age_range.raw_age_text: 8 yrs +

description: Join us for a fall nature walk at Park #566 and experience the beautiful colors, textures, and changing landscape of the season. We’ll explore the many shades of native grasses and dried flower heads while looking for birds that have stayed through the fall or recently arrived to spend the winter. Participants will have an opportunity to help collect native plant seeds and learn more about the importance of these plants for wildlife. You can even create a small fall bouquet to take home and enjoy as autumn décor!

name: Future Folk Festival at Austin Town Hall

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Presented in partnership with Old Town School of Folk Music, featuring Dill Costa Quintet with AKENYA and Shon Dervis Future Folk Festival draws inspiration from the definition of folk music provided by Folk Alliance International: “Folk is the music of the people, reflective of any community where they are from.” Old Town School of Folk Music doesn’t limit folk to any one genre or group of instruments, we prioritize connecting innovative, new, and global folk artists with diverse audiences. Providing a wide variety of music-related experiences with the purpose of strengthening Chicago’s African American, Caribbean, Latinx, African, Asian, and Indigenous communities. Save the date for the full series of Future Folk Festival events: Future Folk Festival: Night 1 featuring Alejandro Salazar and the Afro Cuban Exchange with YAW Thursday, Oct. 22 at 6:00PM • Humboldt Park Future Folk Festival: Night 2 featuring Eva Supreme’s Hymns Reimagined with PRAISE MOTHER SQUAD and Duane Powell Friday, Nov. 13 at 6:00 PM • Douglass Park For more details follow Old Town School of Folk Music's Music Moves page at www.instagram.com/musicmoveschi

Ebenezer Scrooge, a bitter and lonely miser, is visited on Christmas Eve by three ghosts who take him on a journey through his past, present, and future. Along the way, he learns how to once again experience joy, compassion, and the power of generosity. Whether you’re experiencing Scrooge’s transformation for the first time or reliving the magic of the classic story once again, this play enriched with live music will leave you filled with hope and holiday cheer. name: AARP Smart Driver Course

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Co-sponsored by the AARP and Naperville Park District, this program (formerly known as the AARP Driver Safety Program) is a comprehensive driver-retraining course geared to the specific needs of older motorists. Learn the effects of aging and medications on driving, basic driving rules, license renewal procedures, local traffic hazards and more. Designed to improve your driving abilities through additional training, attention and practice, this two-day course helps you drive more safely and keep your driver's license longer. Most auto insurance companies offer a discount for people who attend this class. Call your local insurance agent for more details. The fee is $25 ($20 for AARP card-carrying members). Fees are subject to change. Payment goes directly to instructor. Make checks payable to AARP. Cash is not accepted. Although it is free to book a spot in the class, there is a fee for this program. (bn)

Your inspiration may start with Pinterest, but you will leave the class with art that is uniquely yours. age_range.raw_age_text: 10 yrs +

description: Fencing is a recreational and competitive sport that incorporates agility, strength, coordination, balance and timing. This program focuses on the discipline and training in foil. He has been fencing competitively for over 35 years and is the head coach of RedStar Fencing Club Chicago. Equipment is provided for beginning and intermediate participants; participants enrolled in Fencing Club should purchase their own electric equipment. Participants must have completed beginning fencing and have instructor approval before signing up for intermediate fencing and instructor approval to sign up for Club Fencing. (fg)

name: Fitness: Ageless Grace®: Timeless Fit for the Body and Mind

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Welcome to Ageless Grace®: Timeless Fit for the Body and Mind, a cutting-edge brain fitness program based on neuroplasticity that activates all five functions of the brain-strategic planning, memory/recall, analytical thinking, creativity and imagination and kinesthetic learning while simultaneously addressing all 21 physical skills needed for lifelong optimal function. This unique program works for all ages and all fitness and ability levels. Instructor Cecilia Floyd-Carruthers will teach you the 21 Tools that focus on different anti-aging techniques like Shake It Up Baby, Dance Party, Spaghetti Spine and more, all set to lively and familiar music. Just imagine all of this plus tons of laughter. Stretch, bend and strengthen your core muscles while adding the twist of cognitive learning to build those brain cells. This program works by providing increased stability while seated in a chair! It's time to add fun to exercise and experience the newest way to move both mind and body. Please note that this class is done barefoot while sitting in a chair. Bring comfy socks if needed. No class Sat., Sept. 5, Nov. 28 and Dec. 5. (bn)

name: Fitness: Balance, Breath and Movement (hybrid)

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

Exercises are drawn from Chinese Qi Gongs and Tai Chi movements that work on balance and flexibility, as well as breathing techniques, to enhance the movements and relieve stress. All can be done seated if needed. (bn)

name: Fitness: Regain Your Balance

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Taught by instructor Cecilia Floyd-Carruthers, Regain Your Balance is specifically designed for seniors who are currently mobile and able to support themselves without assistance. As seniors progress and notice a decline in cognitive function, the biggest fear is falling. Consisting of three 15-minute segments of sitting, standing and walking, this class will help you build your confidence and regain or maintain your balance. Fall prevention and how to correctly fall to avoid injuries will be discussed. Please bring water for hydration and wear gym shoes with good support. In order to participate in the Regain Your Balance class, you must be mobile and able to support yourself without assistance. No class Sat., Sept. 5, Nov. 28 and Dec. 5. (bn)

name: Fitness: Senior Kung Fu

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Senior Kung Fu is for the active senior looking for a different type of exercise. Come and have fun learning something new! The class consists of exercises, stance training, Kung Fu Forms (routines of movements), staff routines and two-person applications. (bn)

name: Fitness: Senior Stretch

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Most exercise classes include stretching during warmup and cool down, but what about an entire class dedicated to this important activity? Stretching is vital for seniors and allows for greater movement in joints while improving overall posture in addition to releasing muscle tension and soreness, reducing the risk of injury. It also may help increase circulation, muscle control and improve balance and coordination. This 30-minute class, taught by Cecilia Floyd-Carruthers, covers stretching exercises from head to toe in a seated position as well as standing, using a chair for balance. Please bring water for hydration and wear gym shoes with good support. In order to participate in the Senior Stretch class, you must be mobile and able to support yourself without assistance. No class Sat., Sept. 5, Nov. 28 and Dec. 5. (bn)

name: Fitness: Tai Chi: Adult & Senior-Practice and Instructional

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Looking for better balance, gentle movement, stress relief and moving meditation? Tai Chi might be just what you are looking for and it will complement your other exercise routines. The many benefits of Tai Chi including maintaining mobility, agility, health and vitality can be found in these simple movements. See why Tai Chi has been practiced for centuries to benefit the mind and body. Practice vs Instructional Classes: Practice classes have minimal instruction allowing the student to just follow along in the various exercises and movements to focus on relaxing and breathing. Every level Practice class has a corresponding level Instructional class. Instructional classes provide detailed explanation of everything contained in the Practice class. Ideally, a student would take both. Adult vs Senior Classes: Adult and Senior Tai Chi classes have the same content and instruction. Senior classes are priced for those 50 and over. Anyone 60 and over can register for an Adult Tai Chi class and receive a 20% senior discount. In Person vs Virtual vs Hybrid: Some classes are in person only; some are virtual only (via Zoom) and some are hybrid. Hybrid classes are simultaneously offered in person and via Zoom. If you cannot attend an in-person class on a specific date, you can participate at home via Zoom. (jg)

description: Student gymnasts learn skills pertaining to floor, beam, bars and vault. They focus on building strength, body awareness and hand-eye coordination through repetition of weekly drills and the instruction that is essential to fully develop skills. Each level builds on the previous level with instructor approval and certain skill achievement necessary to move up. Your gymnast should expect to be in a level for a year before advancing. Coaches reserve the right to move the gymnast to the appropriate program if they believe placement is incorrect. Gymnasts must be 6 years old by September 1, 2026 and in first grade to begin this program. (dn)

name: Gymnastics: Tumbling Levels 1-2 Session 2

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Tumbling develops coordination, strength, balance and self-confidence. Level 1 is for children who are new to tumbling. Form and positions will be taught at this level in addition to forward and backward roll, straddle roll, lunge to handstand, cartwheel and bridge. Class is commonly repeated before the instructor recommends moving up to Tumbling 2. Tumbling 2 students will learn handstand forward roll, front limber, back walkover and round off. They may also begin working on back and front handsprings. Instructors reserve the right to move students to appropriate levels. Gymnasts must be 6 years old by September 1, 2026 and in first grade to begin this program. (dn)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 12 yrs

Kids love combining street dance with funk and jazz, similar to what they see in televised dance performances or music videos. This progressive program challenges dancers in a variety of hip-hop and jazz techniques. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 11 yrs

It focuses on age-appropriate dance steps and music. Kids love combining street dance with funk and jazz, similar to what they see in televised dance performances or music videos. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Learn the fundamentals of hip hop dance while strengthening and toning your body and increasing your flexibility. This program is perfect for students new to hip hop dance or those looking to return to the art. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

description: Learn the fundamentals of hip hop dance while strengthening and toning your body and increasing your flexibility. This program is perfect for students new to hip hop dance or those looking to return to the art. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Hippity Hoppers

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program introduces the hip-hop phenomenon to the younger dancer. Students learn basic technique while building strength, balance and musicality. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Hippity Hoppers Recital

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program introduces the hip-hop phenomenon to the younger dancer. Students learn basic technique while building strength, balance and musicality. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Holiday Evergreen Centerpiece

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Learn basic floral design skills while creating a beautiful fresh evergreen centerpiece. Class work will explore tools, evergreen identification, shape, use of textures, floral care and personalization ideas. Design will include fresh evergreens, pinecones, other natural items, seasonal trim and ribbons. All supplies, including tools, are provided but you may bring and add personal touches. (ah)

name: Ice Skating: All Seasons Ice Arena

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Our Staff Coaches at All Seasons Ice Rinks make learning to skate fun and safe for people of all ages and abilities. We follow the curriculum designed by Learn To Skate USA; each level builds upon the skills already mastered. We suggest wearing helmets, gloves/mittens, athletic-like pants, and a warm jacket. We offer skate rental for $24 for each 7-week session or $4 weekly. Free practice times for all class times and one makeup allowed per session. Please call 630-851-0755 or visit www.allseasonsicerinks.com for questions or additional information. (dn)

name: Ice Skating: Rocket Ice

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: The goal at Rocket Ice Arena is to provide a fun and safe environment for skaters to learn to skate and to be able to continue on in hockey or figure skating. From tot and up, lessons are presented in concise levels with each one focusing on skills that will serve as building blocks for future levels. After demonstrating mastery in one level, the student skater may proceed to the next. The curriculum works in conjunction with USFS Basic Skills Program that is taught in quality rinks worldwide. Please wear athletic pants and fleece jacket or similar fitted and warm jacket and bring gloves. Helmets are recommended. We have skates available to rent. Please call 630-679-1700 or visit Rocketice.com if you have any questions. (dn)

name: Ice Skating: Seven Bridges

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: The Seven Bridges Ice Arena philosophy is that anyone can learn to ice skate if they try their best. All ice skating programs feature experienced instructors and free practice sessions. For practice times and more information, please contact Seven Bridges at 630-271-4400. Gloves/mittens and helmets are recommended for skaters and hockey players. Buddy passes are $2 (skate rental not included). Skate rentals are $4 each or 11 for $40. Only one makeup class is allowed per session. (dn) Tots 1 (ages 4-5) - Beginners with no previous instruction. Parent/Tot (ages 3-5) - Beginners with no previous instruction. Basic 1 (ages 6-13) - Beginners with no previous instruction. Little Hockey 1 (ages 4-5) Beginners with no previous instruction Beginner Hockey 1 (ages 6-13) Beginners with no previous instruction

name: Introduction to Quilting

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Join us for an introductory quilting class, no experience needed! Participants will learn how to thread a machine, wind a bobbin, and learn to sew a basic quilt. Sewing machines will be provided for use in class. If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. Supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Introduction to Sewing

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Join us for an introductory sewing class! In this class you will learn how to thread a machine, wind a bobbin, and sew straight lines. Sewing machines will be provided for use in class. If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. A supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Intuitive Painting

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: In this transformative class, you'll explore intuitive painting as a way to quiet the mind and follow the natural energy of your body. Rather than focusing on technique or outcome, you'll engage in open ended, process-based exploration, allowing images and emotions to emerge freely on the page. Whether you're new to painting or returning to your creative roots, this practice invites spontaneity, reflection, and personal insight. Included, or bring your own brush set, fast-drying paints, and paper or canvas. (bd)

name: Irish Dance

age_range.raw_age_text: 5 yrs +

description: Learn reels, jigs, hornpipes and figure dancing. Instructors introduce the excitement of Irish dance and culture. Students must have teacher approval to enroll in the Advanced Level. (sl)

name: Jazz Funk: Level 4/5 Recital

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 13 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Jazz/Funk combines jazz dance fundamentals and hip hop elements with an emphasis on isolations, syncopation and personal style. This high energy class will challenge dancers to learn fast paced choreography to a variety of popular songs with a focus on stage presence, upper body movements, footwork, and floor/tumbling skills. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Jazz: Level 2

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Dancers build technique and begin to use strengthening exercises to build stamina and increase their knowledge of jazz footwork and style. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Jazz: Level 3

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Students expand their jazz dancing with more complicated rhythms and syncopation, build their dance vocabulary, use various dynamics and tempos and investigate numerous styles of jazz. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618.*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Jazz: Level 4

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 13 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Dancers begin to work on more stylized and advanced movements in the technique and perfect their performance quality and artistry. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Kid Rock

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

description: Sing, dance, play, learn, and imagine with us! This movement-based program uses music to facilitate learning. Students will use rhythm instruments and movement props, work on gross and fine motor skills, including balance and coordination, and engage in imaginative play. All classes are structured and include early listening and following directions skills. Join us for a rockin’ good time! www.rockitkids.com (sl)

name: Kids First Badminton Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Playing badminton is fun, whether as a hobby or on a more competitive level. Players are introduced to fundamental badminton skills using drills and scrimmages. Emphasis includes grip, racquet positioning, serving, body balance and first step directional movement. Program concludes with a skills challenge and championship match. Fee includes all equipment. Led by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Baseball Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Batter up! This program challenges all players through fun, competitive drills and games that maximize player potential. Program teaches batting techniques, body balance, throwing, fielding, first-step directional movements, pitching, base running and sportsmanship. It concludes with a championship game. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Players should bring a baseball glove and water bottle. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Basketball Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Learn the basics of basketball with hands-on drills, demonstrations, scrimmages and skills contests leading to the championship game on the last day. Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff focuses on shooting, ball-handling, offensive and defensive skills. Quickness, body balance, first step directional movements, safety and sportsmanship are emphasized. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Cheerleading Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Experienced coaches teach cheer techniques, body balance movements, timing, rhythm, jumps, stunts, cheers and sportsmanship. The final day features a cheer challenge contest. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Dodgeball

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Have a blast running, throwing, dodging and ducking your way to victory. The sport of dodgeball provides great team competition and individual challenge matches. Parents are invited to watch the championship match on the last day. Soft, super-safe balls are used. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Football Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This football program teaches player position fundamentals preparing to play flag and tackle football. Football has twenty-two positions (excluding special teams players) that take time to learn and understand their purpose. The more a player learns, the more confident they become. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. In case of rainout, a makeup is scheduled the week following the end of the session. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Multi-Sport Program

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Experienced Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. coaches teach different sports each day giving kids a chance to learn about new sports and play their favorites. General rules are introduced including safety and fundamentals, and then the game is played. Choices may include basketball, baseball/softball, soccer, flag football, badminton, kickball, volleyball, dodgeball and balloon ball. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Softball Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Batter up! This program challenges all players through fun, competitive drills and games that maximize player potential. Program teaches batting techniques, body balance, throwing, fielding, first-step directional movements, pitching, base running and sportsmanship. It concludes with a championship game. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Players should bring their glove and water bottle. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Speed/Quickness Training

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Playing almost any sport requires quickness. Experienced Kids First coaches teach first step directional movements used in football, track, baseball and soccer. Sport specific drills per sport include individual and team challenge contests. Each participant has an opportunity to learn the quickness component involved for multiple player positions for each sport. General rules of the sport being played are explained; safety and fundamental demonstrations are provided. The last session hosts individual and team challenge contests. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Track & Field Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Learn all about the timed events that make up the sport of track and field. Coaches teach sprints, hurdles, jumps, distance running and throws in a safe and fundamental way. Learn new techniques and strengthen existing skills. There is a mini-meet on the final day. Conducted by coaches from Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Ultimate Frisbee® Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Ultimate Frisbee® is a simple team sport that has been described as a combination of football, soccer and basketball. Certified coaches prepare players to play, enjoy and be successful. Learn basic rules, how to throw and score points offensively and how to protect the goal defensively. Parents are invited to the championship match at the end of the last day. In case of rainout, time will be added equally to remaining sessions. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. (ba)

name: Kids First Volleyball Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Get started playing the fun, action-packed game of volleyball. Players learn fundamental techniques incorporating balance, directional movements, ball handling and sportsmanship through skills drills, visual volleyball safety instruction and games. Conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids' Night Out: Gingerbread Hunt

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Enjoy the night out while your kids have their own fun making Santa hats, decorating cookies, making a Gingerbread Man and having a Gingerbread Hunt. Dinner and juice are provided. Fort Hill Activity Center Fitness members must register in person or over the phone to receive their discount. (km)

name: Kids' Night Out: Gobble Gobble Fun

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Enjoy the night out while your kids have their own fun night filled with Turkey crafts, playing Turkey Relay Races, Pin the Wattle on the Turkey and more. Dinner and juice are provided. Fort Hill Activity Center Fitness members must register in person or over the phone to receive their discount. (km)

name: Landscape Secrets

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Study how master landscape artists used the fundamentals of successful painting to create their extraordinary works. After exploring the techniques of these renowned artists, you'll apply what you've learned to your own landscape paintings. The instructor is trained in watercolor, acrylic, pastel and oil, so bring your favorite medium! (bd)

name: Laugh Out Loud Improv

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Love to laugh? Then this class is for you! Through fast-paced improv games, creative challenges and sketch comedy, you'll build memorable characters, think on your feet and discover the fun of spontaneous performance. Along the way, you'll boost your confidence, strengthen communication and teamwork skills, and share plenty of laughs in a supportive, high-energy environment. No acting experience is necessary, just bring your imagination and willingness to have fun! (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 13 yrs

name: Li'l Artists: Cool Crafts

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Bring your inner creative spirit along to this class that is all about crafts. Create a new craft project each day! Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Builders

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Put on your hard hat and join us as we explore, create and build using a variety of mediums. Arts projects, activities and games are geared toward working constructively to build new creations. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Busy Bees

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 4 yrs

description: Li'l Busy Bees is designed with toddlers in mind. This parent and child program focuses on having fun while engaging in hands-on experiences. Each week brings new activities for children to explore through art, music, sensory activities and movement, with an opportunity for both parent and child to socialize and form new friendships. Infants in carriers are welcome. No class Oct. 21, Nov. 23-26. (sc)

name: Li'l Paleontologist

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Journey to the prehistoric land of dinosaurs. This class incorporates arts, crafts, games and stories to teach pint-sized paleontologists about these amazing extinct creatures. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Scientist: Slime & Grime

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Combine one part science and two parts imagination with some household knowledge and a little dirt. The outcome includes excitingly unusual activities, games and experiments that are sure to capture your attention and make you say WOW! This class is messy; please dress appropriately. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Sprouts

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2y 6m but less than 4 yrs

description: Li'l Sprouts is a fun, learning-based program designed for children who are not quite ready to be away from their parent. Participants have the opportunity to ease into being independent in a classroom setting, with an environment that helps them feel safe and secure in their surroundings. To start, each child will have a parent in their class while they take the time to familiarize themselves with the classroom, the class routine and develop a relationship with their teacher. During the final 2 weeks of the program, participants transition to attending class on their own; this transition may be adjusted to fit the needs of the class. No class Nov. 24 & 26. (sc)

name: Little Actors' Club

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Children love this innovative drama class that develops their imagination and introduces them to the performing arts in a fun and creative atmosphere. Each week is a new and exciting adventure into the imagination with changing themes, costumes or props, music, and games. Participants learn theater terms, a short song, and a new joke every week, enhance spontaneity, build self-esteem, and have plenty of fun in this delightful class. Every session is different and most themes are not repeated for two years so “act” now! (sl)

name: Lyrical/Modern/Contemporary

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Our Lyrical classes offer a first step towards our Modern/Contemporary classes while still working towards building the dancers ballet technique. Modern/Contemporary combines stretching and strengthening to lengthen a dancer's muscles and body. Extensive center warmup and cross floor material is taught. Core strength is developed to facilitate execution of skills and follows traditional styles of movement. This program explores the qualities of released and off-balance dancing while daring students to find disparate qualities of stillness and explosion. Students are encouraged to develop an individual style driven by their internal life and the specificity of their bodies. Prior ballet and/or jazz experience required. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Martial Arts: ISKC Karate Adult

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Illinois Shotokan Karate Club (ISKC) is Chicagoland's premier karate school taught under the instruction of john DiPasquale, a four-time nation Champion, US National Coach and President of the US National Karate Federation. The adult program releases tension, develops total body fitness and builds stamina and overall productivity! In addition to self-defense skills, karate increases flexibility, cardiovascular endurance and muscle tone while improving core strength. (fg) Uniforms and Belt-Testing are options available through the ISKC instructor. Youth, Parent/Child and Adult Classes may train together. Beginner students are not permitted to register for the current session after the second class has met. Registration for continuers through the advanced students is accepted after the start date, but payment of the full fee is required.

name: Martial Arts: ISKC Karate Parent/Child

age_range.raw_age_text: 7 yrs +

description: Illinois Shotokan Karate Club (ISKC) is Chicagoland's premier karate school taught under the instruction of john DiPasquale, a four-time nation Champion, US National Coach and President of the US National Karate Federation. The Parent/Child program is a great way to spend quality time with your child while conditioning muscles, developing coordination and improving cardiovascular fitness. (fg) Uniforms and Belt-Testing are options available through the ISKC instructor. Youth, Parent/Child and Adult Classes may train together. Beginner students are not permitted to register for the current session after the second class has met. Registration for continuers through the advanced students is accepted after the start date, but payment of the full fee is required.

name: Martial Arts: ISKC Karate Youth

age_range.raw_age_text: 7 yrs +

description: Illinois Shotokan Karate Club (ISKC) is Chicagoland's premier karate school taught under the instruction of john DiPasquale, a four-time nation Champion, US National Coach and President of the US National Karate Federation. ISKC's youth program puts children in touch with their bodies and offers a good mix of strength training with cardiovascular and flexibility exercises. Children increase their coordination, agility and poise, as well as learn lasting personal safety skills. They also benefit from the mental stimulation of learning the choreographed moves of the kata and the discipline of conforming to class rules. (fg) Uniforms and Belt-Testing are options available through the ISKC instructor. Youth, Parent/Child and Adult Classes may train together. Beginner students are not permitted to register for the current session after the second class has met. Registration for continuers through the advanced students is accepted after the start date, but payment of the full fee is required.

name: Martial Arts: ISKC Karate/Pre-Karate and Safety

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Illinois Shotokan Karate Club (ISKC) is Chicagoland's premier karate school taught under the instruction of john DiPasquale, a four-time nation Champion, US National Coach and President of the US National Karate Federation. Young children develop flexibility, strength and coordination in fun yet disciplined activities. This program is specifically designed for growing minds and bodies and enhances memory and agility. Watch your child's confidence blossom and their skills improve. (fg) Uniforms and Belt-Testing are options available through the ISKC instructor. Youth, Parent/Child and Adult Classes may train together. Beginner students are not permitted to register for the current session after the second class has met. Registration for continuers through the advanced students is accepted after the start date, but payment of the full fee is required.

name: Martial Arts: Kid's Karate Club and Safety Time

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This progressive martial arts program teaches the basics in karate, self-defense, sparring, kata and children's safety with belt progression through Black Belt. It is taught in a unique way where children are encouraged to have fun and gain confidence. The program targets many building blocks including respect, self-esteem, self-confidence and leadership, but most importantly, family involvement. Parents may participate with their children at no cost as part of the Parent Helper Program. There is a Mandatory Uniform Requirement required for this program, details will be give at first class. For more information, visit www.kidskarate.com. (fg)

name: Martial Arts: Kids Kung Fu

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: The focus in all levels is on building character and personal achievement and not in aggression and competition. Students earn increasingly higher belts as they progress in knowledge and abilities. Information regarding additional costs for T-shirts required for Level 2 & 3 will be discussed at first class and will be purchased directly through instructor. (bn) Level 1 - Students begin with simple exercises and routines that develop confidence and self-discipline as well as build coordination and strength. Level 2 - Students proceed through more difficult routines that demand a higher level of focus and concentration. Two-person Kung Fu practice is introduced that allows the students to develop their skills together. Instructor approval is required. Level 3 - This level is for those students that are on the road to their Kung Fu Black Belt. Training in child-appropriate staff and sword is introduced along with child-appropriate martial arts applications. Instructor approval is required.

name: Meditation for Youth

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: This program is much more than just a basic class on calming the body and mind. Participants will learn the tools needed for managing a multitude of concerns including stress, anxiety, emotions, family togetherness, and more. As they progress from youth and adolescence, participants will benefit from understanding the importance of mindfulness and coping skills. Jitendra Desai employs the right method for teaching and helping students tap into the proper ways of handling difficult situations that arise. (km)

name: Mini Music Makers

Each class focuses on dance technique, acting, singing skills and team building. It is perfect for the seasoned performer or those who want to enhance their skills. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

The session culminates in a one-of-a-kind performance. (sl)

You will move using scarves, hoops, & stick ponies, and enjoy music time together while improving gross and fine motor coordination. Every music session is filled with new songs, activities and many wonderful instruments. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: +Participants enjoy playing in a fun, recreational atmosphere. Games are played at Naperville Yard Sports Complex on Saturdays between 8:00 am and 4:30 pm. Kits include: Information/instruction sheets, coloring pages and/or scavengers hunts, supplies for crafts and materials/instructions for a game or two. age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 4 yrs

Join a naturalist for a fall multi-week session. Each themed, but unstructured, nature playtime takes place completely outdoors rain or shine so dress for the weather. Please note: Your child may get wet and dirty - it's part of the fun! Caregivers stay with their child. (ah)

name: New Horizons Band DuPage

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: New Horizons Band DuPage provides musical instrument instruction and music-making for active adults and seniors, including those with no previous musical experience and those who have been musically inactive. Learn how to read music and play a musical instrument, or jump right in and participate in a concert band (musical instrument experience required). Every person has musical potential that can be developed to a level that will be personally rewarding. Individuals are encouraged to practice on their own outside of class and may be invited to perform in concerts at the end of each season. Each participant must own, purchase, rent or borrow the band instrument that they choose to play. New Horizons Band DuPage has some instruments that can be rented or can suggest locations where instruments can be rented or purchased. Music method books are required for the beginner and intermediate classes. Payment of $13 will be collected at the first class (price subject to change). Please make checks payable to New Horizons Band. Visit www.nhbdupage.org for more information. It's never too late to toot your own horn! (bn)

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Build your painting skills by learning and applying techniques made famous by Donna Dewberry. Through practice, become proficient in proper brush loading, which is the key to one-stroke painting success! Then, test your artistry to create a variety of leaves and flowers with shading and highlighting effects using just one stroke of the brush. You'll want to paint everything you can get your hands on! All supplies are available for a fee of $25 payable to instructor at the first class. (bd)

name: Parent/Child Holiday Ornaments

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

name: Parent/Child Introduction to Sewing

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Join us for an introductory sewing class, no experience needed! Participants will learn how to thread a machine, wind a bobbin, and sew a fun project. Sewing machines will be provided for use in class. If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. Class is open to ages 7-18. Parents need to attend class with children ages 7-11. Adults who are assisting children do not need a separate registration as they will be working on a single project together. A supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Join Glitzy Girlz for our most treasured holiday gift class. Each couple will team up to make special hand-made gifts for family & friends. You will make and take home three personalized gifts consisting of crafts and a jewelry piece. The gifts can be made for girls and boys of all ages using a wide variety of beads and trinkets. Each pair will have supplies to make gift bags, tags and tissue to conceal the holiday surprises! Parents must accompany their child and participate in class. (bd)

name: Parking Permits

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 15 yrs but less than 20 yrs

description: The Naperville Park District offers parking spaces for Neuqua Valley and Naperville Central High School students. Permit holders will be eligible for parking in the designated spaces at the Skate Park lot at Frontier, the gravel lot off of West Street or the designated spaces at the Centennial Beach parking lot. Permits purchased online will be mailed to the address listed on your account within two weeks of purchase. If you purchase online, your receipt will act as your confirmation of purchase until your receive your permit. Please print your receipt and place it on your dashboard until your permit arrives. Permits also may be purchased in person at the Alfred Rubin Riverwalk Community Center, the Knoch Knolls Nature Center or the Fort Hill Activity Center. Applications must be signed by a parent or guardian. Spaces are not assigned and are available first come, first served ONLINE REGISTRATION OPENS JULY 11, 2026. WALK IN WILL BE AVAILABLE JULY 11, 2026. CHECK WEBSITE FOR FACILITY HOURS. If you are participating in your school lottery for a permit, please wait for those results before purchasing an NPD parking permit.

name: Pickleball

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Pickleball is a fast-growing racket sport that is best described as a mix of badminton, tennis and ping-pong that can be played by nearly everyone. Program consists of instruction followed by actual game play. Players should wear athletic shoes and dress as for tennis. Equipment is provided, but bring your own pickleball paddle if you have one. (ba)

Lessons with one of our Certified Pros are $79 per hour. Purchase a five-lesson package and save. To schedule a private lesson, register for the lesson and a staff member will be in touch with you to schedule the day and time. Lesson cancelations must be done 24 hours in advance in order to receive a credit. (ba)

It focuses on engaging little ones with familiar music in a high-energy environment introducing ballet technique while building coordination skills, memory and listening skills. Adult is free and must accompany child; maximum two children per adult. Please register each child separately. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: The unique environment of a pottery studio is relaxing and conducive to creativity. Learn basic hand-building and surfacing techniques, the production stages of glazing and how to design and develop projects. All supplies are included. (bd)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Build castles, make coil pots or create a favorite animal - the possibilities are endless! Learn basic hand-building techniques and the stages of the glazing process. Program may be repeated. All materials provided. Please wear old clothes. Parents please stop by Studio One the week after the session ends to pick up your child's creations. (bd)

name: Pottery II

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Build on the basic techniques of this art and learn more advanced hand-building techniques. Both beginning and returning students are welcome. Please wear old clothes. All materials are provided. Parents please stop by Studio One the week after the session ends to pick up your child's creations. (bd)

name: Pottery: Family Open Studio

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: Use our pottery studio and receive guided pottery instruction as a family! All materials provided. Come to class with ideas or photos of what you would like to make. Participants should wear old clothes or bring their own apron. Please register each person in the family. Multiple families may register for the same date until class size has reached a maximum of eight participants. (bd)

name: Pottery: Gingerbread Houses

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Create your own winter wonderland in this hands-on pottery class! Students will construct their own gingerbread houses, decorate them with textures and clay-made candy, and fill them with snowmen, gingerbread men, and whatever your heart desires to create a unique holiday focal point. Each week will build upon the work done in the previous class, so weekly attendance is mandatory to successfully complete the project. Previous pottery experience recommended, but not required. Please wear old clothes. (bd)

name: Pottery: Teen

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Learn hand-building and surfacing techniques, the stages of the glazing process and how to design and develop projects. Please wear old clothes. All materials are provided. Parents please stop into Studio One at the beginning of the first class to confirm contact information, class times and participant pick up instructions. (bd)

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Build posture, strength, balance, and mobility by leveraging body weight using TRX straps combined with the cardio power of boxing. Form and technique are instructor-monitored with any necessary modifications provided by certified boxing and TRX trainer(s) to enable participants to be safely challenged. Enjoy all the fun and challenge of a typical TRX class combined with elements of boxing. Participants need to bring their own boxing gloves. (km)

name: Premier: Meditation

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Meditation is known for its benefits of helping people let go and move forward successfully through their journey. Our meditation practice is structured to target several areas of life events, and each week our Meditation instructor, Jitendra Desai, will speak about a new topic. Jitendra will guide you through meditation to help you move forward in healing and learning how to handle and alleviate daily stress. Participants have the option to take this class in-person or virtually via Zoom. Please have a current email on file to receive the Zoom link. (km)

name: Premier: Self Defense Clinic

age_range.raw_age_text: 13 yrs +

description: Stay safe. Stay smart. Stay strong. Join us for a dynamic 2-hour self-defense clinic that goes beyond just physical techniques. Learn how to enhance your situational awareness, avoid dangerous situations, and protect yourself if needed. This hands-on class will teach you effective self-defense moves and safety strategies to boost your confidence and preparedness. For member pricing please register at the front desk or call 630-995-8900 (km)

Expect to be challenged safely and confidently as you work toward your personal fitness goals. Fort Hill Fitness members, contact the Fort Hill Activity Center at 630-995-8900 to register. (km)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Experience a hands-on introduction to piano with instructors from Edge Music Academy! In this interactive, personalized semi-private lesson, get a taste for what it's like to learn to play the piano. EMA's lesson philosophy focuses on providing a strong foundation of music fundamentals and technique, while allowing students to explore playing in a wide variety of styles that appeal to your child's interests. The fee includes a required piano book. (sl)

name: Seminar: Legacy Planning for Your Final Transition

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: Planning for the final transition, whether for yourself or for someone you love, is a deeply personal and often emotional process. Thoughtful planning is one of the most meaningful gifts you can give yourself and those you care about. It provides direction, reduces uncertainty, and creates a sense of comfort during life’s most challenging moments. It involves more than organizing documents. It’s about honoring wishes, preserving dignity, and easing the responsibilities that fall on family during an already difficult time. Join this seminar to learn about beginning the conversation early, exploring planning tools such as secure digital vaults, and seeking support when you need it. Whether you are preparing in advance or navigating arrangements after a loss, resources are available to help you feel informed and supported. While this is a free event, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Medicare Options

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: Learn the basics of Medicare including eligibility and coverage choices such as prescription drugs. If you are confused about your current plan choices during the upcoming Open Enrollment period, turning 65 or just looking for a better overall understanding of the Medicare process, this presentation is for you. Presentation provided by AdSum. Although this program is free, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Spotting Charity Scams

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: In this season of giving, make sure your generosity reaches the people and causes you care about most. Scammers often pose as legitimate charities, making it increasingly difficult to tell the difference between a genuine request for help and a fraudulent one. Join us to learn how to identify common warning signs of charitable scams and gain a better understanding of the difference between tax-deductible and tax-exempt organizations so you can give with confidence. This presentation is provided by Naperville Bank & Trust. Space is limited. While this program is free, registration is required. (bn)

name: Shape and Tone

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Reshape and tone your body through the use of weights, squats, Pilates moves, push-ups and much more! This program increases bone density through the use of muscle-strengthening exercises and is suitable for all levels. (km)

name: SHIP-December

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: SHIP is the Illinois State Health Insurance Assistance Program. Whether you are new to Medicare or already enrolled, SHIP is a great way to get information and answers about health insurance coverage for seniors. If you are considering a prescription drug plan, please bring your Medicare card, any other insurance cards and a list of your medications, including dosage and frequency to your appointment. If you would like to see if you might be eligible for financial help in paying for Medicare, bring your most recent tax return. Open Enrollment occurs every year between October 15 and December 7. Appointments during this time frame are for those who would like to review their Medicare Part C coverage or Part D prescription plans to insure you have the most comprehensive, cost efficient coverage for the upcoming year. Information on health insurance coverage for seniors includes the following: Medicare A & B (hospital/doctor), Medicare C (Medicare Advantage Plans/HMO, PPO, PFFS), Medicare D (Prescription Drug Plans), Medicare Supplemental Policies (Medigap), Long Term Care Insurance and Medicaid Programs. Counselors are trained and sponsored by the State of Illinois Department on Aging. Appointments are available between 9:00 a.m. and 11:00 a.m. To register, call 630-848-5000 or go online to napervilleparks.org to book an appointment with a SHIP counselor. (bn)

name: Soccer: Chicago Fire Thanksgiving Break Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Chicago Fire FC Camps are designed for children of all ages and abilities to develop their soccer skills through a tailored camp curriculum.With small group instruction, certified, professional coaches will guide campers through activities structured around daily themes, including dribbling, passing, attacking, and defending. Chicago Fire FC Camps incorporate nationally recognized SEL (Social and Emotional Learning) traits and values like self-awareness, responsible decision-making, and teamwork into activities. Campers should bring a water bottle, soccer ball and gym shoes or cleats and a sack lunch (for full day campers). (sa)

name: Social Bridge Lessons for Beginners

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: Bridge is a fun and intellectually stimulating game that can be enjoyed for a lifetime. This is a friendly and relaxed six-week course designed for beginners. It will introduce you to the fundamentals of social bridge, including basic bidding and responding, play of the cards, and special situations. Each session combines instruction with guided practice, so you can learn by playing. Whether you are looking to meet new people, challenge your mind, or learn a new hobby, this course is the perfect place to start. No previous experience is necessary. While the course is free, registration and regular attendance are required. (bn)

name: Softball League: Fall Men's 12-inch

There is an additional $20 per nonresident team member fee. (ba)

name: Softball: Team Waivers and Rosters

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Members of adult softball league teams must register to be placed on their team's roster and complete the waiver. Players who have not registered will not be allowed to participate. Do not register unless you have been invited by your team captain. (gf)

name: Speed and Agility Training

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Take your athletic performance to the next level with Speed and Agility at the Hudson Sportsplex. This program improves acceleration, footwork, change of direction, balance, coordination and overall athleticism through age-appropriate drills and expert coaching. Open to athletes of all sports and skill levels looking to become faster, quicker and more explosive. (ba)

name: STEAM Club - Hands On Scientific Explorations!

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: We are back for a second round of STEAM Club! If you missed us the first session no worries, as each time we start a new session we bring in all new topics in STEAM. Everything we do is entirely hands-on and participants get to be the scientists with us. We'll build bug bots, exploding rockets make slime, and so much more. Please bring a spill-proof water bottle. (bd)

name: STEAM Club - You are the Scientist!

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: High Touch High Tech Chicagoland is ready to help inspire your scientists. Our STEAM club will be filled with hands-on experimenting where the participants get to do everything themselves. Every day will be a fun-filled scientific surprise where we will explode volcanoes, touch real squid go panning for gemstones and explore so much more in every session. Scientists will bring home their experiments. Get ready to watch your future scientists be inspired. Please bring a spill-proof water bottle. (bd)

name: Storybook Dance

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

It teaches dance in a creative atmosphere while strengthening basic motor and social skills. Using costumes, lively music and storytelling, fairy tales become real and each beloved character comes to life. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 17 yrs

Lessons are scheduled at your convivence. You will be contacted to schedule your lessons. If a session needs to be canceled there is a 24 hour notice policy. Each package includes 4 lessons. Lesson times available are 9:30-10:00, 10:05-10:35, 10:40-11:10 and 11:15-11:45. (cj)

Swimming requires advanced motor coordination that takes practice; it is normal for a swimmer to remain at the same level for more than one session. If, after a session begins, we believe a swimmer has been placed in an inappropriate level, we will make the adjustment to ensure that every child will feel comfortable at their assigned level. (jg)

age_range.raw_age_text: 4 yrs +

Lessons with one of our USPTA/USPTR Certified Pros are $79 per hour. Purchase a five-lesson package and save 10%. Purchase a ten-lesson package and save 15%. To schedule a private lesson, register for the lesson and a staff member will be in touch with you to schedule the day and time. (ba)

name: Tinkering Lab

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

Children are encouraged to experiment, ask questions, test ideas, and discover how things work through open-ended play. Through collaboration with peers, they share ideas, work together on projects, practice communication skills, and learn from one another's perspectives. Activities may include building structures, designing simple inventions, exploring cause and effect, and engaging in cooperative challenges. The Tinkering Lab fosters creativity, critical thinking, teamwork, perseverance, and confidence while nurturing a love of exploration and innovation. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. No class Nov. 27. (sc)

Captains will be contacted with schedules. All fees are per team plus $20 per nonresident player. (ba)

name: Volleyball: EVP Junior Volleykidz USA

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Volleykidz is an introductory class that introduces the pass, set and spike using a very light volleyball. Volleykidz will improve each child's hand/eye coordination and left/right coordination through the use of fun drills and games. Instruction also incorporates short educational drills including spelling, math and science. (ba)

name: Volleyball: EVP Volley Series Match Play

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Interested in playing volleyball matches with other volleyball training to compete in grade school and highschool? Our volleyball pro will develop a team with weekly instruction to prepare for games against other athletes. The coaches' lesson plan will guide the team in weekly training for 90 minutes. At weekly practice the teams will play matches and learn team defense and offense positions while they improve on their fundamentals of passing, setting, spiking, and overhand serving. This is a 4-week program that meets once per week for 90 minutes. Each athlete receives a Volley Series t-shirt at the 1st event. (ba)

name: Volleyball: EVP Volleykidz USA

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 10 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Improve your volleyball skills with drills in setting, passing, overhand serving and spiking. The lesson plan directs the use of individual training, pairing drills and game situation development that help each student reach a new level. Instructors organize short games at the end of each class. The lesson plan also incorporates leadership and educational components. (ba)
