name: Wellness Series: Heart Health

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Join us for a community talk on Heart Disease and Heart Health. Dr. Jeffrey Ziffra of Advocate Good Samaritan Hospital will discuss blood pressure goals for cardiovascular disease protection, the benefits of cardiovascular exercise, diet and cholesterol recommendations and how to detect cardiac disease. This wellness series talk is free for fitness members, please register at the Main Service Desk at Fort Hill. (km)

name: Winter Break: 5 Star Soccer Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: The 5 Star Soccer Camps offer a fresh, enthusiastic approach to teaching youth soccer. Our curriculum presents the most current and advanced information on the development of the youth soccer player. Our quality staff builds on fundamental techniques while creating an atmosphere that unlocks the game within each child. We believe in our program, designed for success, that presents a positive, enjoyable environment for learning from proven coaches in youth soccer.(sa)

name: Winter Break: Chess Wizards

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Chess Wizards is a premier chess education company providing fun, informative and challenging chess experiences. They provide an interactive, discovery-based curriculum to inspire students to think ahead, visualize their goals, win graciously and accept defeat with dignity and sportsmanship. This multi-day winter break camp is geared to suit children of all skill levels with a goal of helping participants build their knowledge and chess-playing confidence through lessons and tournament play while having fun! (bd)

name: Winter Break: Dinosaur Adventures Mini Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 9 yrs

description: There's an explorer in all of us and if you're ready for an expedition in dinosaur discovery, this is for you! T-Rexplorers take you on an adventure straight from the Cretaceous period with this unique, hands-on exploration of dinosaur science and paleontology. Hold real dinosaur bones like those seen in museums! Conduct investigations of different authentic dinosaur fossil types from species like Triceratops and T-Rex. Enjoy discovery, humor, fun, games and an activity or craft to take home. You'll be going outdoors (weather permitting) so dress accordingly. Please bring lunch, snack and water bottle. (bd)

name: Winter Break: Gymnastics Camps

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Learn and develop new gymnastics/tumbling skills. Enjoy a variety of games and meet new friends. All experience levels are welcome; campers are grouped by skill level. Please bring water each day. (dn)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Badminton Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Experienced coaches from Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. teach badminton fundamentals using competitive drills that develop skills. Grip, racquet positioning, serving, body balance and first-step directional movement are emphasized. Camp concludes with a skills challenge and championship game. All equipment is provided. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Baseball/Softball Skills Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Brush up on the fundamentals of baseball/softball and have fun improving batting, throwing, fielding and base running skills and learning all about teamwork. Camp concludes with a championship game. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. Players should bring their own glove and wear gym shoes; cleats are not allowed in the gym. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Basketball Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Basketball games plus fundamentals make this holiday camp special! Experienced coaches from Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. teach basketball skills and safety to get you game ready. Camp offers skills contests and championship games. Skills to include: shooting, dribbling, passing, speed and quickness, body balance, first step directional movements and floor spacing. Basketball safety awareness and sportsmanship also will be covered. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Cheerleading Skills Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Experienced coaches teach cheerleading skills using fun drills to enhance techniques. Body balance, timing, rhythm, pom-pom bebop dance, jumps, stunts, cheers, rah-rah awareness and sportsmanship are emphasized. Camp concludes with a performance for parents on the final day. Conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Dodgeball Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Have a blast running, throwing, dodging and ducking your way to victory! Camp features many types of games and matches each day with a championship match on the last day. Only safe, gator-skin balls are used. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Flag Football Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Touchdown! Spend your break learning and practicing fundamental football skills and strategies. Indoor flag football equipment is used to teach the techniques of the sport through drills and scrimmages. A championship game is played on the last day. This camp is conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Multi-Sport Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Experienced coaches teach different sports each day giving kids a chance to learn about new sports and play their favorites. General rules are introduced including safety and fundamentals, and then the game is played. Choices may include basketball, baseball/softball, soccer, flag football, T-ball/Blast ball, kickball, dodgeball and balloon ball. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Speed Training Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Coaches focus on teaching sprints, hurdles, jumps, running and throws in a safe and fundamental way. The program consists of body-balance techniques and speed, quickness and agility drills designed to produce a safer, more powerful athlete. A series of team relay races makes the program fun and entertaining. Conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Track and Field Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Camp introduces many of the events that make up the sport of track and field. Learn new techniques and strengthen existing skills. Focus is on teaching the basics of sprints, hurdles, jumps, quickness and throws in a safe and fundamental way. There is a mini-meet at the end of the week. Conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Ultimate Frisbee® Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. certified coaches prepare players to play, enjoy and win in a team concept at Ultimate Frisbee® - one of the fastest growing team sports in the country! Ultimate can be described as a combination of soccer, football and basketball. It's a simple-to-learn, yet demanding game. Offensive and defensive drills are supplemented by games leading to a championship match on the final day. (ba)

name: Winter Break: Kids First Volleyball Basics Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Players learn fundamental volleyball techniques incorporating balance, directional movement, ball handling and sportsmanship. Excellent coaches prepare kids to succeed using drills, games and instruction each day. Conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. (ba)

name: Winter Break: RoboThink STEM Robotics Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: This winter break, build amazing robots and engage in robotic challenges and games! Equipped with RoboThink's innovative kits, including gears, motors, sensors and mainboards, campers build and play with robots of all shapes, sizes and functions. Instructors take participants on a fun journey, learning about robotics principles and problem solving. The activities are interactive, hands-on and engaging to promote learning in a fun way. Different content will be taught at each camp, so participants can register for either or both sessions. (bd)

name: Winter Break: Sewing Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 18 yrs

If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. Supply fee is $20 payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Winter Break: The STEAM Team

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

This three-day adventure will have your future scientists exploring different Chemical, Physical, and Life Sciences. On our final day they get to have a parent or guardian join them for the final hour as they get to recreate and teach you how to do their favorite experiment they learned while with us all week! Lab coats and goggles are included. Please bring a nut-free snack and spill proof water bottle. We will have a snack break each day. (bd)

name: Winter Break: Volleyball EVP Camps

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 15 yrs

The lesson plan directs the use of self-mastery training that helps each student reach a new level. The knowledge of the instructors will give the participants a head start on their skills in preparation for club team play. (ba)

Students complete several different projects and learn to draw whimsical characters, animals, everyday objects, and action scenes. Young Rembrandts artists gain so much confidence. Double your child's creative spirit and art skills. Add this camp to your child's schedule. Don't miss out, sign up today! (bd)

name: Yoga Gold

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Yoga Gold is a yoga class choreographed specifically for the Active Older Adult (AOA). This class will move your whole body through a complete series of seated and standing yoga poses. Chair support is offered to safely perform a variety of postures designed to increase flexibility, balance and range of motion. (km)

name: Yoga: Beginner/Intermediate

age_range.raw_age_text: 16 yrs +

description: Yoga for Beginners/Intermediate level students is the perfect class for individuals just starting a yoga practice or for those with some basic experience and knowledge. This small group class offers more individualized attention to help participants further develop a mind and body connection while improving internal focus, balance, flexibility and strength at each student's pace. Achieve a calm mind using the therapeutic breath and meditation techniques that yoga provides. (km)

name: Yoga: Gentle Yoga

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Start with gentle movements and breathing practices to safely stretch the body and relax the nervous system. Postures are held for longer lengths of time and props are used to support a deep sense of letting go with maximum comfort. End with a guided meditation/relaxation that deeply calms the body, mind and spirit. This beginner-friendly program is geared toward individual needs and uses props. All students are welcome. (km)

name: Yoga: Hatha Yoga - Hybrid

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Benefit from an ancient system that attends to the total health of the body and mind. Yoga exercises are coordinated with deep breathing to help bring the body into proper alignment. Benefits include muscle balance, strength and elasticity, increased range of motion, improved coordination and improved function of internal glands and organs. Please bring an exercise mat and a large towel. Participants have the choice to take this class in-person or virtually via Zoom. (km)

name: Yoga: Intermediate/Advanced

age_range.raw_age_text: 16 yrs +

description: Find the peace amid the chaos with small group yoga. Experience the original and timeless mind and body practice. As you seek your internal focus, balance, flexibility and strength, calm the mind with breathing and meditation techniques that yoga has to offer. This class is for level intermediate/advanced. (km)

name: Young Actors' Club

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 9 yrs

description: Join the fun and be a part of this wonderful and fast-paced creative drama class. Each week is a new and exciting adventure into the imagination with changing themes, costumes or props, music, and games. You’ll even learn a short song and a new joke every week! Learn theater terms, enhance spontaneity, build self-esteem, and have a blast! Every session is different and most themes are not repeated for two years. Want to do something fun? Join the club! (sl)

name: Young Rembrandts Double the Fun Drawing

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Here's an exciting experience for your imaginative child that is sure to awaken their inner artist! We'll explore all the basics of visual arts in a fun and confident setting that ensures success for every child, focusing on basic drawing, portraits, action, and cartooning. Students complete several different projects and learn to draw whimsical characters, animals, everyday objects, and action scenes. Young Rembrandts artists gain so much confidence. Double your child's creative spirit and art skills. Add this workshop to your child's schedule. Don't miss out, sign up today! (bd)

name: Heritage Oaks Simulator League

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 16 yrs but less than 75 yrs

description: Compete in our indoor virtual golf league this offseason at Heritage Oaks. Full Swing Golf simulators feature the best graphics and real time ball flight on world class golf courses such as Pebble Beach, PGA National, St. Andrews Links, nine TPC Courses and more. League Format: Two-player teams will post a weekly combined gross score on six pre-determined golf courses during the regular season. All teams will play the same course conditions, with tee yardages designated for men and women. Teams will be awarded points during the regular season to earn a spot in the single elimination playoff bracket. (To qualify for the playoffs teams must complete at least 5 rounds by dates assigned) Weekly Closest to the Pin, Longest Drive and Longest Putt competitions add to the fun for all participants. A rolling handicap will be calculated during the regular season on a weekly basis using a triple bogey max, and will be applied during the playoff matches. During the playoffs each player will receive 70% of their handicap to determine the total net score. Ties will be broken using a scorecard playoff using the USGA method, last 6 holes, then last three holes, and finally the 9th hole. Regular Season: Oct. 19 - Nov 29 Playoffs: Nov 30 – Jan 10 Nine Hole Matches with a 9-Hole Championship Match League Fees: $60 per player for regular season and post season payouts, plus weekly contests (CTP, Long Drive, Long Putt) League rounds can be booked up to 14-days prior at the standard hourly simulator rental rates between 9am-8pm by calling the golf shop or on-line seven days in-advance. Enjoy the added flexibility to play any time that fits your schedule, and play rounds ahead of time as needed. Rules and Eligibility: Must be 21 years of age or older.

Put your skills to the test! • Accepting a friendly stranger • Sitting politely for petting • Appearance and grooming • Out for a walk on loose leash • Walking through a crowd • Sit and down on cue and stay in place • Coming when called • Reaction to another dog • Reaction to distraction • Supervised Separation Classes are provided by certified trainer and behavior consultant, Angela DePalma, with Sit, Stay, Thrive. name: Northbrook Pickleball Co-Ed League - 60+ Intermediate

age_range.raw_age_text: 60 yrs +

description: Enjoy a fun, social and competitive league that allows you to play with a variety of players each week as you look to make your way to the top court. Register individually. Participants will play five games each week. Our leagues are categorized by skill level. We kindly request that you carefully review the description of each level and register for the one that best matches your abilities. Advanced Beginner (2.0): Players at this level understand the rules, know how to keep score, can hit forehands, backhands, and volleys, and can serve accurately. They also know where to stand when serving and returning. Low Intermediate (2.5): Players at this level know the basic rules and the two-bounce rule, can hit forehands and backhands with direction, serve accurately, sustain a dink rally, volley with some direction, understand the fundamentals, and keep score accurately. Intermediate (3.0): Players at this level can hit medium-paced forehands and backhands, serve with depth and accuracy, control a dink rally, hit medium-paced third-shot drops, and volley with direction. They understand the fundamentals of the game, positioning, and may have tournament experience. High Intermediate (3.5): Players at this level can use forehands and backhands with moderate control, consistently get serves and returns in, serve deep, and return deep. They can sustain medium-length dink rallies, control the height and depth of dink shots, and understand the variation of pace for dink shots. Advanced (4.0): Players at this level possess all the skills mentioned above and are accurate with overhead shots, can sustain dink rallies with control, height, and pace, consistently execute third-shot drops from the baseline, and can switch between soft and power shots. They can also block and return fast, hard volleys and are aware of their partner’s position on the court.

name: Pickleball Co-Ed League - Advanced Beginner/Low Intermediate

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Enjoy a fun, social and competitive league that allows you to play with a variety of players each week as you look to make your way to the top court. Register individually. Participants will play five games each week. Our leagues are categorized by skill level. We kindly request that you carefully review the description of each level and register for the one that best matches your abilities. Advanced Beginner (2.0): Players at this level understand the rules, know how to keep score, can hit forehands, backhands, and volleys, and can serve accurately. They also know where to stand when serving and returning. Low Intermediate (2.5): Players at this level know the basic rules and the two-bounce rule, can hit forehands and backhands with direction, serve accurately, sustain a dink rally, volley with some direction, understand the fundamentals, and keep score accurately. Intermediate (3.0): Players at this level can hit medium-paced forehands and backhands, serve with depth and accuracy, control a dink rally, hit medium-paced third-shot drops, and volley with direction. They understand the fundamentals of the game, positioning, and may have tournament experience. High Intermediate (3.5): Players at this level can use forehands and backhands with moderate control, consistently get serves and returns in, serve deep, and return deep. They can sustain medium-length dink rallies, control the height and depth of dink shots, and understand the variation of pace for dink shots. Advanced (4.0): Players at this level possess all the skills mentioned above and are accurate with overhead shots, can sustain dink rallies with control, height, and pace, consistently execute third-shot drops from the baseline, and can switch between soft and power shots. They can also block and return fast, hard volleys and are aware of their partner’s position on the court. No class 9/21

description: Come learn about how the railroad has impacted the histories of Arlington Heights, Des Plaines, and Mount Prospect. Discover local history on the big screen with staff of the Arlington Heights Historical Museum, Des Plaines History Center, and Mount Prospect Historical Society for a viewing of their new documentary, Railroad Ties. name: Trees, Traditions & A Tale of Hope Tour

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Trees, Traditions & A Tale of Hope Griffin Museum of Science & Industry Chicago, Illinois Monday, November 23, 2026 11:00 AM – 6:30 PM The annual Christmas Around the World and Holidays of Light exhibition features more than 50 trees and displays, each lovingly decorated by community volunteers who share their family and cultural traditions drawn from their global heritage. Throughout the exhibition, you will find displays representing international seasonal celebrations of light, including Hanukkah, Kwanzaa, Diwali and more. This beloved annual event began in 1942 with a single tree symbolizing unity during World War II and has since transformed into an engaging winter wonderland. Admission includes entry to Anne Frank: The Exhibition. Take in the immersive, full-scale recreation of the Annex where Anne Frank, her family and four other Jewish individuals lived in hiding during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands. Explore the world that shaped Anne’s story - from her early childhood in Frankfurt to the rise of Nazi Germany and the spread of antisemitism across Europe, culminating in the Frank family's escape to Amsterdam. Time is also provided to view the museum’s extensive interactive exhibits, historic artifacts and immersive science adventures housed in the last remaining building from the 1893 World's Fair. Bring money for lunch, snacks or shopping at the museum. Must register by November 6.

description: A Celtic Christmas Batavia Fine Arts Center Batavia, Illinois Wednesday, December 2, 2026 5:15 PM – 11:00 PM The internationally acclaimed A Taste of Ireland Company presents its holiday spectacular, A Celtic Christmas. Some of the world’s finest Irish dancers and musicians will bring the spirit of Christmas to life in a show that will make you laugh, cry and sing into the night. Featuring former World Irish dance champions and stars from Lord of the Dance and Riverdance, A Celtic Christmas offers a holiday celebration filled with Irish wit, traditional tunes and heartfelt ballads, alongside all your favorite carols. Whether you have Irish heritage, dream of visiting Ireland or are experiencing an Irish Christmas for the first time, A Celtic Christmas is a holiday spectacular you won’t forget. name: A Christmas Story: The Musical Tour

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: A Christmas Story: The Musical The Fireside Theatre & Jones Market Fort Atkinson, Wisconsin Friday, December 4, 2026 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM Join us for a delightful day of shopping, dining and holiday fun! Our adventure begins at The Jones Market, famous for its locally made specialties, LIKE fresh brats, Italian sausage and gourmet Wisconsin treats. Your purchases will be labeled and refrigerated while we enjoy the rest of our day. Next, we head to The Fireside Theatre for a pre-show luncheon. Our menu includes cream of lobster soup, freshly baked bread, a choice of entrée and Black Forest Cake for dessert. Coffee, tea and milk are included. Entrée choices are: Grilled Atlantic Salmon, with a homemade creamy dill sauce, roasted butternut squash and Brussels sprouts with cherrywood smoked Canadian bacon Sliced Roast Beef Tenderloin, with Bearnaise sauce, roasted butternut squash and Brussels sprouts with cherrywood smoked Canadian bacon Chicken Parmesan, with fettuccini noodles and tomato sauce, served with Brussels sprouts with cherrywood smoked Canadian bacon Vegetarian Puff Pastry Pot Pie, served with a hearty vegetable reduction sauce After lunch, we take our seats for A Christmas Story: The Musical, which brings the beloved 1983 holiday film to life on stage. The story follows the heartwarming and humorous quest of nine-year-old Ralphie Parker, set in 1940s Indiana. Young Ralphie dreams of finding the ultimate Christmas present, a Red Ryder Carbine-Action 200-shot Range Model Air Rifle, beneath his family’s tree. Despite warnings from his parents and teachers telling him, “You’ll shoot your eye out,” Ralphie remains undeterred and concocts imaginative schemes to make his Christmas wish come true. Before heading home, we will make a quick stop back at The Jones Market to pick up any purchases.

name: Merry Milwaukee!

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Merry Milwaukee! The Pabst Mansion & Mader’s Restaurant Milwaukee, Wisconsin Monday, December 7, 2026 8:15 AM – 5:00 PM Christmas at the Pabst Mansion is a beloved annual holiday tradition in Milwaukee. This historic home, built in 1892 for beer baron Captain Frederick Pabst, is transformed into a festive winter wonderland. Stroll through the 20,000-square-foot Flemish Renaissance Revival mansion at your own pace to enjoy the holiday atmosphere. The mansion features three floors filled with stunning decorations, sparkling lights and dozens of beautifully styled Christmas trees arranged in 23 distinct areas. After visiting the mansion, enjoy lunch at Mader’s German Restaurant in downtown Milwaukee. During the holiday season, the restaurant transforms into a festive, Old-World winter wonderland, complete with traditional German decorations and twinkling lights. Lunch includes bread service, a house salad, a choice of entrée and apple strudel. Coffee, tea, and soda are included. A cash bar is available. Entrée choices are: Sauerbraten: marinated roast beef finished with gingersnap sauce, sour cream and toasted almonds, served with red cabbage and spätzle Wiener Schnitzel: boneless pork cutlet, lightly breaded and sauteed golden brown, served with spätzle, sauerkraut and lemon Herbed Salmon: salmon filet with parsley lemon breadcrumbs, chive oil and beurre blanc sauce, served with red pepper spätzle and seasonal vegetables

name: *Kindergarten Co-Ed Basketball - Winter

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Youth Basketball League Our youth basketball league is a fun and engaging program designed to learn fundamentals, build confidence and develop a love for the game. The league includes practices and games coached by volunteers focusing on development and healthy competition. Each team will be scheduled for one weekday practice and 1-2 weekend games. Games are played on Saturdays and occasionally Sundays with possible bye weeks or double headers. Practice day, time and location for your team are determined by the volunteer coach. Information regarding team placement, practice times and games schedules will be shared 1-2 weeks prior to the start of the season. Interested in Coaching? Check “Yes” during registration if you’re interested in being a volunteer coach! We’ll reach out as the season nears to establish a practice slot that works with your schedule and help prepare you for a great season. You will be asked to attend our mandatory coaches meeting 1 week prior to the start of the season. Questions? Please email Laura Husko, Athletics Supervisor, at Lhusko@ahpd.org or review our FAQs for Players/Parents . (LH)

name: Santa's Flight to Schaumburg

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: This event is sponsored by Schaumburg Bank & Trust . Santa is arriving by helicopter and you’re invited to give him a warm welcome! While you wait for Santa in the airport’s hangar, enjoy a buffet breakfast (for lunch, please register for the 1-3 p.m. time slot) plus holiday music and crafts. As Santa approaches, the hangar doors will open to watch him land! Don't forget your phone or camera for a photo with Santa! After he disembarks from the helicopter everyone will get a chance to talk to him. There is complimentary registration for children ages 2 and younger; all attending family members must register. Children must be accompanied by an adult during the entire event. Arrival: The doors to the hanger are located on the lower level of the main entrance and will open at 8:30 a.m., 30 minutes before the event start time. There is one elevator located next to the stairwell. There is limited space at the entryway and the line typically wraps outdoors- please dress for the weather. Seating is first come, first serve. Location: Schaumburg Regional Airport, 905 W. Irving Park Road, Schaumburg

name: Schaumburg Children's Theater: Mary Poppins

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 18 yrs

Using a combination of magic and common sense, she must teach the family members how to value each other again. name: Teen Ballet 1

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Beginning level classes focus on the basics of ballet including proper placement and posture; body positions, plies, tendus, battements, and port de bras. Emphasis will be placed on understanding technique, as well as instilling an appreciation and enjoyment of the movement. Advanced levels are a continual study of fundamentals, extended to emotional expression and precision, as well as developing fluid artistic control. Ballet is the basis of all other dance forms and can strongly enhance any athletic activity. We strongly encourage that ballet be taken in conjunction with any other dance class.

name: Teen Contemporary 2

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Contemporary is a merging of both ballet and jazz styles of dance, combining jazz skills with the ease and gracefulness of ballet. This style of dance focuses on an emotional connection to the lyrics of a song and expressing that through movement. This challenges the student to connect on a deeper level to the dance and to become a part of the music.

name: Teen Hip Hop 3

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Hip-Hop is a high intensity dance form that is often paired with the latest hip-hop music. Having evolved from “street dancing”, Hip-Hop has an edgy component which is taught through isolations of the body in addition to alternating between smooth and quick, sharp movements. This class will increase flexibility and coordination by challenging the pace at which the dancer’s body can move. This class helps express personality through movement that allows for a little attitude.

name: Teen Jazz 1

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 18 yrs

All jazz classes will have a strong foundation in ballet with an emphasis on correct body alignment and technique. Jazz classes focus on isolations, turns, jumps, leaps, increased flexibility, strength and an overall development of style.

age_range.raw_age_text: 1 yr +

description: All aboard for a magical Holiday Movie Night featuring The Polar Express ! Enjoy popcorn, refreshments, crafts, and plenty of hot cocoa inspired by the movie's famous "Hot Chocolate" celebration. Join us as we journey to the North Pole and celebrate the magic of the season with a special surprise visit from Santa! Bring your holiday spirit, your pajamas, and most importantly—your belief in the wonder of Christmas. (GS)

name: Family Open Gym - KRC

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: FREE! Get your game on and play with the whole family this winter at Family Open Gym. Every Sunday November 1-December 27. Ages 3-14 with adult. Each adult and child must register to attend . (TGI) This is not a drop-off program, a guardian must remain with children at all times.

name: Friday Friendventures: A Character Exploration

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Friday Morning Adventures is an engaging preschool class where children explore a different popular character each week. From superheroes and princesses to animals and explorers, each theme comes to life through crafts, stories, music, and movement activities. In a fun and supportive environment, children build creativity, social skills, and confidence while making new friends and learning through play. Every Friday morning is a new adventure filled with imagination, laughter, and hands-on fun! We will be having a themed snack so please make us aware of any allergies. Bring a filled, labeled water bottle to class. (CB)

name: Full STEAM Ahead

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Explore gravity and force by knocking things down with a pendulum and setting off chain reactions. Plan and build structures, conduct experiments, investigate living things, and learn how to work as a team. This action-packed class will prove that your STEAM investigator can be an engineer, biologist, chemist, and mathematician all while having fun! Topic of the week and activities are the same in both the Monday and Wednesday classes. (CB)

name: Fun Fall Wreaths

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Celebrate the season together in our Fun Fall Wreaths class! Caregivers and children will team up to design and decorate a beautiful autumn wreath using colorful leaves, seasonal accents, and creative touches. This hands-on class is full of creativity, teamwork, and festive fun as families craft a one-of-a-kind decoration to take home. Enjoy quality time, make special memories, and welcome fall with a project you’ll be proud to display! (CB)

name: Fun Fall Wreaths

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Celebrate the season together in our Fun Fall Wreaths class! Caregivers and children will team up to design and decorate a beautiful autumn wreath using colorful leaves, seasonal accents, and creative touches. name: Garden Plots

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: REGISTRATION FOR NEW GARDENERS STARTS MARCH 19 at 8 am! Grow your own produce in an approximately 20' X 20' Elmhurst Garden Plot at Marjorie Davis Park. The Park District will rototill and stake each area, you plant, cultivate and reap the harvest. Six water taps are available and are open 9 am - 9 pm, seven days a week. Weather permitting, growing season runs from May - November 1. A maximum of one garden plot per family is allowed. RETURNING PARTICIPANTS: We will continue to give returning customers (those who had plots in 2025) the option of keeping the same plot or entering the lottery for a new plot. Returning participants must register between February 21-March 13 to secure a plot for 2026. NEW PARTICIPANTS: Those who did not have a plot in 2025 WILL BE ABLE TO REGISTER BETWEEN MARCH 19 (Beginning at 8 am) AND APRIL 5 for any available plots. Available plots will be sold on a first come first served basis. A lottery will be held for plot selection. New gardeners that get a plot will receive more information on how the lottery to choose your plot works after April 5. The lottery for plot selection will be held on Wednesday, April 15 at 6:30 pm at the Kies Recreation Center. (AS)

name: Gentle Yoga

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Give yourself one hour of breath work, gentle stretches, and mini meditation to calm the nervous system. Escape from the stress of everyday life and leave feeling calm and peaceful. All levels are welcome. Great for stretching and de-stressing. You don't have to be a yogi to take this class. Participants should bring a yoga or exercise mat to class. (AS)

name: Get Grinched

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Get a visit from Whoville’s very own Grinch this holiday season! The Grinch will leave a “You’ve Been Grinched” sign with a small grinch-mas gift. That’s right, you can send Mr. Not-so-Jolly to someone else’s house as a surprise! Grinching will take place the week of December 7-10 between the hours of 4-6pm. Open to Elmhurst Park District resident addresses only. (GS)

name: Gingerbread House Decorating

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Make this holiday season extra special by decorating a gingerbread house with your child! A pre-assembled gingerbread house will be supplied to each registered child. Using a variety of sweets and candies, participants will use their creativity to decorate their gingerbread house. Leave the clean-up to us while you create long lasting holiday memories with your little one! Dress to make a mess! (CB) Registration Deadline: December 1

name: Girls Advanced Gymnastics Fall II

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Girls Advanced is for gymnasts who have mastered Intermediate skills. Emphasis will be on perfecting the skills learned, the introduction of more difficult skills on each event and increasing flexibility and strength on floor, bars, beam and vault. Gymnasts will begin working on connecting skills as well as flip flops, back walkovers and limbers. Classes are one hour twenty-five minutes in length. Prerequisite: Approval from Girls Intermediate. (KG)

name: Girls Beginner Gymnastics Fall II

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: The focus of this 55-minute class is on the development of gymnastics skills on vault, bars, beam and floor. On vault, students will learn how to run and jump on the springboard, working on a good stick landing. On bars the focus is basic hanging and support skills. On balance beam, posture, balance and a variety of basic skills will be introduced. On floor the focus will be rolls, cartwheels, handstands and jumps. (KG)

name: Girls Competitive Gymnastics-Meets

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Gymnastics Meets are for Members of our Competitive Teams.

name: Girls Competitive Gymnastics-School Year

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Our Competitive Girls program participates in the Amateur Athletic Union (AAU) League. We believe that gymnastics teaches life skills along with the greatest overall body conditioning your child could be involved in. Properly taught gymnastics teaches, self-motivation, self-discipline, pride, dedication, determination, work ethic, time management, teamwork, team spirit, leadership, sportsmanship, respect for others, poise, and grace. The competitive program is invitation only. (KG)

name: Girls Developmental Gymnastics

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Our Girls Developmental Program focuses on advanced tumbling and equipment skills, with emphasis on progressive skills leading to the competitive gymnastics level. The gymnast is also introduced to dance elements in the gymnastics setting. At this level, self discipline and internal motivation become emerging benefits for the athlete. The goal is for the gymnast to eventually move into our competitive team once skills and techniques are mastered. This program is by invitation only. (KG)

name: Girls Intermediate Gymnastics Fall II

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Girls Intermediate Gymnastics is for girls who have mastered Beginner skills and would like to develop new skills. On vault, students will learn dive rolls and handstand positions using the springboard. On bars the emphasis will be placed on swinging skills such as back hip circles. Scales, leaps and turns will be introduced on balance beam. Back bends, kick overs, round offs and handstand forward rolls will be the focus on floor. Classes are 55 minutes in length. Prerequisite: Approval from Girls Beginner. (KG)

name: Girls Rising Stars Gymnastics

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Our Girls Rising Stars Program focuses on advanced tumbling and equipment skills, with emphasis on progressive skills leading to the competitive gymnastics level. The gymnast is also introduced to dance elements in the gymnastics setting. At this level, self discipline and internal motivation become emerging benefits for the athlete. The goal is for the gymnast to eventually move into our competitive team once skills and techniques are mastered. This program is by invitation only. (KG)

name: Glitzy Girlz: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun Slumber Night

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Come join Glitzy Girlz for a night of old-fashioned girls time fun! Wear your fav stylish pajamas to this sleep-under complete with fun music & new friends. Our staff will be running crafts, beads, nail station and dancing. Decorate a personalized overnight bag & beaded fun keychain complete with cool charms. Girls will get nails and toes polished and nail stickers. End the night with some dancing to music favorites! Sign up with friends! (BS)

name: Glitzy Girlz: Holiday Gift Making Memories

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Come join Glitzy Girlz to attend our most treasured holiday gift class. Each couple will be teaming up to make special hand-made gifts for family & friends. They will make and take home (3) personalized gifts consisting of crafts and a jewelry piece. The gifts can be made for girls and boys of all ages and a large selection of unique beads will be provided for all gifts. Each couple will also get supplies to make gift Bags, tags and tissue to conceal the holiday surprises! You MUST attend this most special memory of 2026 with your kids! (BS)

description: Golf Fitness will help stabilize and challenge the muscle groups used in your golf game. A great way to get in or stay in golf shape to make sure your golf game is on par.

This year's event will be held at Kies Recreation Center and will include a delicious lunch, entertainment, a visit from a very special someone, and raffles (tickets available for purchase at the event). name: Hot Shots Sports: Adult/Tot Baseball

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Parents are an integral part of helping their tots develop basic sports movement and motor skills through the great sport of baseball. Motor skills activities focus on hand/eye and running coordination. Sports equipment and instruction are provided to help guide your child through an introduction to organized sports. Participants should bring their own gloves if desired. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Adult/Tot Basketball

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This special clinic offers an opportunity for parents and their child to work together and develop basic basketball fundamentals. The clinic focuses on drills that parents can do one-on-one with their child. Basketball fundamentals covered include shooting, passing and dribbling. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Adult/Tot Flag Football

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This football program includes exclusively designed equipment tailored to enhance the early football experience for each participant. The program challenges children to develop new cognitive, physical, and social skills. In addition, each child will experience social interaction with children and adults in a fun environment. Adult participation required. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Adult/Tot Soccer

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Young Children develop motor skills while having fun running and kicking. Parents and tots work together in this class learning the basics of soccer. Dribbling, passing, shooting, and kicking will be emphasized. A variety of activities will be played each week. Adult participation required. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Adult/Tot Sports

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Parents are an integral part of helping their tots develop basic sports movement and motor skills. Motor skill activities focus on hand/eye and hand/foot coordination. Sports equipment and instruction are provided to help guide your child through an introduction to organized sports. Parent or caregiver participation is required. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Floor Hockey

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This clinic provides participants the opportunity to learn and play floor hockey in a safe and fun environment. Players learn positions, stick handling and ball control in this fun, fast-paced class. In addition, players develop teamwork and sportsmanship while having fun competitive gameplay each week. Safety and having fun is a MUST when you step on the floor. Come ready to play! (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Game Time Flag Football

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 10 yrs but less than 14 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Players experience daily scrimmages with active instruction and tips from the coaching staff. Players are encouraged to employ skill used in football such as running pass routes, play calling, defensive positioning, the fundamentals of blocking and pass coverage. These skills and others will be used in a “game time” environment while the players scrimmage each week. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Jr. Flag Football

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Come join in on the fun and start playing the nation’s most loved game! Players are introduced to stance, receiving, rushing, blocking and defense. Each week ends with a scrimmage encouraging teamwork and sportsmanship. Players always get to play either receiver or running back each week. Games focus on fundamentals and field concepts, as well as positions and mechanics. No equipment necessary! (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Lil Dribblers

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: The Lil’ Dribblers Basketball program introduces children to the game of basketball in a safe, fun and exciting environment. Our curriculum uses age-appropriate activities and games specifically designed to increase balance, body awareness, motor skills, hand eye coordination, listening skills and the ability to follow directions. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Lil' Runners

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 8 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Children are introduced to the sport of track and field using appropriate running and movement games. Each week, children will be taught a specific element of track and field all while having fun! Appropriate equipment will be used for games and exercises. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Pee Wee Flag Football

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 7 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Players improve athletic ability and increase football knowledge in this fun filled skills clinic. Teamwork and sportsmanship are stressed while playing various games that teach the fundamentals of throwing, running routes and defense. All children have a blast, regardless of their prior skill level. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Pee Wee Floor Hockey

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 7 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Pee Wee Floor Hockey players play with pillow polo sticks, which have a soft-cushion end. Participants learn the basics of the game and experience the thrills of being a hockey player! (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Pee Wee Soccer

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: Let your child’s early soccer experience be a great one. The younger player develops their soccer skills and also gains confidence, coordination, motor skills and communication. The program uses age-appropriate drills and exercises to teach players kicking, ball control, dribbling, shooting and more. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Rookie Baseball

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 9 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This baseball class gives players an introduction to baseball. This program teaches throwing mechanics as well as batting stance, bat positioning and speed, using both live pitching and hitting off the tee. Players learn various positions in the field through game play and basic in-game strategy. Players should bring their own gloves, and be ready for a fun, fast paced learning environment. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Rookie Dribblers

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 9 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: The Rookie Dribblers program is designed to progress children through their early basketball experience. Simple skills are reinforced, and other aspects of the game are introduced in a fun and supportive environment. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Speed & Agility

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 12 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This class is designed to improve overall coordination and athleticism. Each week will focus on introducing and developing basic and advanced kinetic movements. The progression program includes drills and activities aimed to improve; agility, speed, endurance and explosive power. This is the perfect program to supplement your child’s other sport participation. Participants see improvements in coordination, speed, and reaction time. Our experienced instructors work hard to keep a fun, exciting and engaging atmosphere. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: T-Ball Skills Clinic

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This introductory T-ball program is perfect for a child who wants to have fun, make new friends and be introduced to the game of baseball. Participants enjoy learning the skills needed to play baseball including offense and defense, as well as the rules and philosophies of the game. The program stresses teamwork over competition. All you need to bring is a glove! (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Total Sports

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 7 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This class features a new sport each week. Some of the sports taught and played include basketball, floor hockey, football, kickball, soccer, and baseball. In addition, participants play many popular running and group games. Children have the opportunity to acquire new skills and develop confidence in games they have played in previous classes. (TGI)

name: Hot Shots Sports: Volleyball Skills Clinic

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

location: Ray Graham Association: Elmhurst Cmty Learnin
description: This clinic includes instruction on all major volleyball skills; serving, passing, setting and attacking. Players receive a solid foundation of these fundamental skills through fun and active drills, building up to team play. This class is for the volleyball beginner looking to understand the game and learn new skills. Kneepads are recommended. (TGI)

name: Intermediate Tumbling Fall II

name: Intro to Cheer & Poms

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Get ready to jump, shout, and shake those poms! This high-energy class is perfect for young athletes who want to explore the exciting world of cheerleading and poms. In this fun and encouraging environment, kids will learn basic cheer motions, jumps, and chants, pom dance routines set to upbeat, kid-friendly music, and more. This class will spend the first 4 weeks on Poms skills in the dance studio and the second 4 weeks in the Gymnastics Center working on cheer. (KG)

name: Intro to Gymnastics Fall II

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 4 yrs

description: Intro to Gymnastics is designed for 3 year old gymnasts that might not be ready for class without their parents/guardians. This class will work on easing the gymnasts into a class without their parent/guardian in attendance. Parents/guardians will be required to attend the first 2 classes with their gymnast. The second 2 classes, the parents/guardians will remain in the class, but sitting on the side. For the remainder of the session, the gymnasts will be working with the instructors on their own. Parents/guardians will be able to remain on the side of the class for as long as the gymnast needs them. One parent/guardian will be allowed for each registered gymnast. Siblings will only be allowed in this class if they are able to remain in a baby carrier for the duration of class. (KG)

name: Irish Dance Private Lessons

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 99 yrs

age_range.raw_age_text: 16 yrs +

description: Relax and de-stress as you are bathed by candlelight and sound at the historic Wilder Mansion. Experience the mental and physical health benefits of live sound meditation as you are guided on a journey in sound and deep listening by Certified Sound Bath and Meditation facilitator Dana Kraszczynski. A Sound Bath, or Sound Meditation, is a deep immersion in sound that is felt in your whole being. Find a comfortable seat or lie down and allow the soothing vibrations of singing bowls, flutes, and chimes to wash over your whole body, creating a gentle yet deeply transformative effect on your body and mind. The intention of this practice is to guide you into a state of deep relaxation. No special skills, abilities, or beliefs are required to receive the benefits. Please bring something comfortable to sit or lay down on such as a yoga mat, blankets, and/or pillows.

name: Sound Healing Therapy

Gentle, rhythmic tones can help slow brain activity, relax the body, and create a sense of safety and presence, allowing participants to move into a deeper state of rest and mental clarity without physical effort. Leave the mental overload of the week behind and start your weekend off rested, calm, and emotionally balanced. (AS)

description: Get your spoon, paintbrush and chocolate syrup ready - we’re going to create Art! We’ll build spaghetti sculptures, learn about food artists, paint a chocolate portrait and much more. It’s all about the wonderful and wacky world of food art! (No peanut or peanut oils will be used).

name: Abrakadoodle Doodlers - Winter Wonderland Art Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Create snowy owls, winter villages and warm cups of cocoa. Celebrate winter with creativity, inspired by artists like Tom Baker and his snowy window landscapes. Warm-up with Heather Galler and her colorful folk-art paintings. Have fun with Albert Laessie and his playful penguin sculptures. Use your imagination to create a winter wonderland.

name: Abrakadoodle Mini Doodlers - Fairy Tale Art

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3y 6m but less than 6 yrs

description: Gleefully create your own masterpieces using a wide range of quality art materials through creativity and imagination. Develop skills important for school success such as fine motor skills, language, cognitive skills and the ability to listen and follow directions in an enchanting environment. Themes change each session.

name: Abrakadoodle Twoosy Doodlers - Fairy Tale Art

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 3 yrs

description: Develop sensory and gross motor skills through games, music and art . Learn about color, texture, and more while experimenting with new, engaging materials. Themes change each session.

name: ACT 1: Acting Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Recommended for new or beginning acting students who want to participate in the next play or musical. Focus on the fundamentals of acting through sensory, observation and relaxation exercises and games. This class provide actors the groundwork to take the stage with confidence and culminates wit a fun mini showcase on the last day of class.

name: ACT 2: Acting in Performance

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Work on getting to the next level of performing for an audience in this introductory class. Extend your craft by digging deeper into character work, objectives, relationships, and putting the words into action to develop a scene or monologue. Individualized coaching on techniques and methods for performance will allow each actor to set goals and fix performance gaps.

name: Acting for Kids

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Aspiring actors can build skills like public speaking and confidence through vocal and movement exercises, improvisation, and character development. Class will culminate in a performance of scenes from popular plays and movies.

name: Acting for Tots

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Little actors and actresses will use their imagination to explore the world of theatre! Students will learn through fun acting exercises and silly vocal techniques.

name: Adult Cabaret

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Celebrate the community’s entertainment talent with a high-energy performance for adults! A live piano player will be onstage for all performances. Email video submissions to tosika@genevaparks.com by Nov 5. Performance: 11/21 @ 7pm Tickets: $10 in advance, $15 day-of

name: Adult Improv Experience Presents...Ha! Ha! Holiday Showcase

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Get ready to laugh your way into the holiday spirit! Explore the art of unscripted comedy with a festive twist. Over the course of this high-energy workshop, learn the fundamentals of improv through games, scenes, and creative collaboration—culminating in a live final showcase packed with holiday hilarity. Whether a seasoned performer or brand new to improv, this is your chance to jump into the spotlight and sleigh the stage with some spontaneous holiday cheer! Rehearsals: Su 3-5pm, 11/1 – 12/13 Dress Rehearsal: 12/18 at 7pm Performance: 12/19; 6pm call time, 7pm show Tickets: $10 in advance, $15 day of

name: Adult/Tot Basketball

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 5 yrs

description: Work together to develop the basic basketball skills of shooting, passing and dribbling. Coaches will teach parents drills to practice with their child.

name: AI Coding for Kids

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Spark curiosity and build future-ready skills by blending creativity, coding, and real-world tech. Learn what AI is and how it works in everyday life by understanding how computers make decisions, recognize patterns, and how to train simple AI models using MIT's Scratch®. Students should be familiar with using a computer. *NO CLASS 11/25

name: Almost 2: Look What I Can Do!

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 2y 6m

description: You and your child will have the opportunity to socialize with other families, while children develop essential skills for future learning. We'll sing, dance, read stories, make books, and craft, We'll nurture natural curiosity, and allow time for free exploration. Every week promises a morning of fun!

name: Arena Flag Football League

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 11 yrs

location: Geneva Park District - Persinger Rec Ctr
description: Designed to teach and enhance the skills of future star athletes while making it fun and eliminating the intense win-at-all-cost attitude! Play all positions to truly learn the game from different angles. There will be MINIMAL CONTACT and NO TACKLING during games. Learn the sport in a safe environment before tackle football is an option. Games played 6v6.

name: Art of Nature

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Nurture your love of art during our nature-themed paint program. An instructor will give step-by-step instructions. Paint, brushes, and canvas will be provided. Wear a paint shirt or short sleeves. Snacks provided.

name: ASL for Mom/Dad and Me

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Interested in learning the basics of American Sign Language or communicating with your young child through signing? Join us from the comfort and convenience of your living room as you learn to sign in a fun, interactive and lively environment. Each session covers new material. Taught live on the Zoom platform by a Language in Action, Inc. instructor. Zoom login information will be emailed to participants prior to the first class.

Required attire: leotard, footed tights and pink ballet shoes for girls, fitted athletic wear and black ballet shoes for boys. Hair pulled back, out of face.

name: Ballet/Jazz 1

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Learn 2 styles of dance! For ballet, focus on the foundation of dance through barre, center work, and across-the-floor activities. For jazz, learn traditional jazz dance basics set to upbeat, engaging music. Instructors emphasize proper dance technique, body placement, poise, grace and classical terminology in an encouraging, fun environment. Required attire: leotard with tights or jazz pants. Pink ballet shoes for girls, black for boys; Tan Jazz shoes. Hair pulled back, out of face.

name: Ballroom Dance - Advanced

age_range.raw_age_text: 16 yrs +

description: Take your dancing to the next level! Expand your fancy footwork skills to wow the crowds at weddings or work functions. Review introductory patterns of the most popular dances: Waltz, Foxtrot, Swing, Tango, Rumba and Cha-Cha. Improve your leading, following and various rhythm styles. Wear smooth-soled shoes that allow you to slide and spin freely. Ladies should wear a 2-inch or lower heel for proper balance. Fee is per couple. Taking Beginning Ballroom is not a prerequisite, but is highly recommended.

name: Ballroom Dance - Beginner

age_range.raw_age_text: 16 yrs +

description: Put on your dancing shoes! Develop the skills needed to feel confident on the dance floor whether you're getting ready for a wedding or work function. Learn introductory patterns of the most popular dances: Waltz, Foxtrot, and Swing. Learn leading, following and various rhythm styles. Wear smooth-soled shoes that allow you to slide and spin freely. Ladies should wear a 2-inch or lower heel for proper balance. Fee is per couple.

name: Baseball Camp

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 9 yrs

description: Learn everything about baseball! Camp focuses on pitching, hitting, bunting, base running, in fielding, out fielding, catching and offensive/defensive strategies. Teamwork and a positive mental attitude are emphasized. Bring a glove.

It’s a great way to improve posture, balance and overall health. Dress comfortably.

Whether you're taking your first steps onto the dance floor or looking to refine your moves, this class offers a welcoming and energetic environment. Learn popular moves including the half turn, quarter turn, and 3-quater turns while applying the moves to R&B music. Lead by Certified Line Dancing Instructor.

age_range.raw_age_text: 11 yrs +

Morning preschoolers can be escorted to class.

name: Chair Volleyball Clash

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Get ready for a fun-filled day of friendly competition and connection! Our chair volleyball team is hitting the road to take on another spirited group of players on their home court in Aurora. Enjoy the thrill of the game, cheer on great plays, and celebrate teamwork at every serve. After the match, stick around to relax, laugh, and refuel with a delicious lunch shared among friends—because the best part of the game is the community we build along the way! Transportation and lunch included.

Every player will get the opportunity to play each position as teams are kept small so that there is no sitting while players are in the field defensively. This will be an introduction to live pitching from a coach but a batting T may still be used.

name: Coding Through Play

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Jump into the world of coding with exciting games, active play, imaginative stories, and hands-on challenges that bring technology to life. Learn how to follow and create simple sequences, recognize patterns, give directions, and solve problems using screen-free, step-by-step coding experiences. Through play, develop early computational thinking skills while fostering teamwork and communication. Discover how coding is simply another way to think, create, and solve problems. Morning preschoolers can be escorted to class.

name: Contemporary 2/3

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Contemporary dance combines elements of ballet, modern, and jazz techniques and utilizes emotional expression as well as storytelling to convey a message to the audience. The focus is on finding freedom in movement through floorwork, grounding, and contraction/release while developing body awareness, improvisational skills, self-expression, and self-confidence. Required attire: leotard or fitted athletic clothing and contemporary half-sole shoes or barefoot.

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 7 yrs

Children will learn about ingredients, follow simple directions, and discover connections between the story and the cooking experience. Along the way, they'll build confidence in the kitchen, develop fine motor skills, and enjoy creating tasty treats to share.
